channel.title: OakFox Journal
channel.description: Articles on sustainability, branding, design, and development from OakFox — a sustainable design studio in West Lancashire, UK.

item.title: We Audited the Websites of 18 Businesses That Sell Sustainability
item.description: Refill shops, net-zero consultants, solar installers — businesses whose product is sustainability. Their websites ran the full scale from A+ to F, and the difference comes down to four patterns anyone can copy.
item.author: OakFox

item.title: We Audited 100 UK Small Business Websites for Carbon. Here's What We Found.
item.description: Original data: we ran our carbon audit crawler over 100 real UK small-business homepages across 18 sectors. Median weight 1.8 MB, 44% rated E or F, and images account for 60% of every byte transferred.
item.author: OakFox

item.title: Rebranding Without Greenwashing: A Practical Checklist
item.description: A field-tested checklist for refreshing a brand around sustainability without overclaiming — what to verify before you say it, which claims are safe, and where businesses trip themselves up.
item.author: OakFox

item.title: Managed Green Hosting vs DIY: What Small UK Businesses Actually Need
item.description: Self-hosting on a green platform looks cheap until you count your own time. When managed green hosting earns its keep for a small UK business — and when DIY is genuinely fine.
item.author: OakFox

item.title: Introducing EcoScribe: Automation That Gives Ecologists Their Week Back
item.description: EcoScribe is a new venture from the OakFox team. It automates the report writing, grant drafting, and compliance paperwork that eats ecologists' weeks — PEA, BNG, and SFI — without ever touching the ecological judgement. Here's why we built it.
item.author: OakFox

item.title: What Makes a Brand Sustainable (Beyond a Green Logo)
item.description: Sustainable branding is a set of operating decisions, not a colour palette. What it actually means for identity, materials, messaging, and the claims you can credibly make.
item.author: OakFox

item.title: Building TrailFox: Designing an Outdoor Activity App for Families
item.description: How we designed, built, and launched TrailFox — our second in-house app. The energy-and-place mechanic, designing for use outdoors in bright sunlight, shipping iOS and Android together, privacy-first handling of children's data, and why we chose one-time packs over subscriptions.
item.author: OakFox

item.title: Is Your Web Host Actually Green? A 30-Second Check
item.description: How to verify whether your web host really runs on renewable energy — the public registry to check, what 'carbon neutral' claims actually mean, and what to do if your host fails the test.
item.author: OakFox

item.title: Why Most Small Businesses Shouldn't Self-Host on Cloudflare Pages (Even Though It's Free)
item.description: Cloudflare Pages is the cheapest, fastest, greenest static host going. So why do most small businesses get bitten by it? Where the free tier wins, and where managed green hosting earns its keep.
item.author: OakFox

item.title: Building CubTrack: Designing a Calm Baby Tracking App for UK Parents
item.description: How we built CubTrack, a baby tracking app for Android — the brand decisions, UX choices for one-handed use at 3am, the Android stack, and what we learned shipping a freemium product end-to-end.
item.author: OakFox

item.title: How to Write Sustainability Claims That Aren't Greenwashing
item.description: A practical guide to writing sustainability claims that hold up to scrutiny — under UK CMA guidance, EU Green Claims Directive, and basic customer trust. With real examples of what to say, what not to say, and why.
item.author: OakFox

item.title: Sustainable Web Design: A Practical Guide for UK Businesses
item.description: What sustainable web design actually means, how much energy your website uses, and the specific changes that cut emissions — with real numbers, not marketing lines.
item.author: OakFox

item.title: Best Green Web Hosting UK: 6 Providers Compared (2026)
item.description: The best green web hosting providers for the UK in 2026, compared. Six verified renewable-powered hosts — prices, UK data centre locations, performance, and what 'carbon neutral' really means.
item.author: OakFox

item.title: The Future of Sustainability in Branding and Marketing
item.description: Sustainability isn't a trend — it's becoming the baseline. Here's how branding and marketing are shifting, and what it means for businesses that want to stay relevant.
item.author: OakFox

item.title: Choosing a Brand Name: A Practical Process (With Real Examples)
item.description: How to choose a brand name that works commercially and legally. The process we use at OakFox — with a checklist, worked examples, and the mistakes to avoid.
item.author: OakFox

item.title: How to Brief a Branding Agency (Without Wasting Anyone's Time)
item.description: A practical guide to writing a brief that gets you a better proposal, a better quote, and a better project. With the questions to answer, the mistakes to avoid, and a template you can actually use.
item.author: OakFox

item.title: Welcome to the New OakFox
item.description: We've rebuilt our website from the ground up using modern web technology. Here's why we made the switch and what it means for our clients.
